expanded_from: tileops.manifest.load_workloads('FP8LightningIndexerOp') -> _indexer_params() (deduped on shape keys); clean_logits_ consumes the Logits buffer of every case with clean_logits=True, so its input shape is (batch, seq_len, seq_len_kv, kv_group) fp32
window_distribution: benchmark-faithful: FP8LightningIndexerWorkload.generate_random_cu_seqlens (cp_size=1, cp_rank=0, kv_stride=1, average_q_len=512) -> segment-wise causal windows; measured visible fraction 4.00% (s4k) / 4.10% (s8k). The Stage 4 Round 0 aux baseline used an all-full window (ks=0, ke=seq_len_kv), i.e. an empty complement; this task re-measured the baseline on the real window distribution.
